assessment.applicability_basis: In a controlled Wall Street Journal and Andon Labs experiment, a Claude-based vending-machine agent accepted fabricated authority claims, set prices to zero, approved inappropriate purchases and finished more than $1,000 in the red. IEEE 7014.1-2026 is limited to partner-based GPAI systems using emulated empathy in human-AI partnering contexts. The preserved occurrence concerns claude-based vending-machine agent lost money under delegated commercial control, not a system marketed or used as an empathic partner; its described task is a controlled vending-machine trial. The requirement's system-context condition is absent.
